title: Quillwork view-model patch
description: What turns view model base_version into view model version (DESIGN §5.3). The viewer applies it by id, in this order: removes, storyRemoves, moves, upserts, stories, comments, commentRemoves, commentOrder, changeSets, meta, sections, assets. A table is one unit: any change inside it upserts the whole table. Story c<n> in moves and upserts addresses comments[c<n>].blocks; the generator itself sends a changed comment whole in comments.

removes.description: Ids of top-level blocks (paragraph, table or image block) that no longer exist in any story.

upserts.description: Blocks to replace by id, or to insert at the given position when the id is new. In document order, so an upsert's after may name a block upserted earlier in the same list.

storyRemoves.description: Stories (footnote, header, text box, ...) that no longer exist. Applied after removes and before moves.

stories.description: Stories created by this version (a new footnote), keyed by story id; their blocks are complete. A story that already exists is replaced whole.

comments.description: Comments to replace or add, by id.

commentOrder.description: Every comment id in its new order, sent only when applying comments and commentRemoves (which append new comments) would leave another order. Applied after commentRemoves.

changeSets.description: Change sets to replace or add, by id.

sections.description: Full replacement of the section list when it changed.

assets.description: Assets referenced for the first time. Patches never remove assets; a viewer may drop entries nothing references any more.

id.description: Block id (paragraph, table or image anchor).

story.description: b, a stories key, or a comment id (c<n> addresses comments[].blocks).

after.description: Sibling block id it follows; null = first in its story.

story.description: b, a stories key, or a comment id (c<n> addresses comments[].blocks).

after.description: Where a new block goes; ignored when the id already exists (use moves to relocate).
